newsitem.title: USA: Continental available seat mile rev up 4pct.
newsitem.headline: Continental available seat mile rev up 4pct.

text.p: Continental Airlines Inc on Wednesday reported revenue per available seat mile rose 4 percent in the third quarter, from $0.0943 a year ago to $0.0981.

The company said available seat mile increased only 1.9 percent from a year ago to $0.086, excluding the fleet charge. Continental cited higher fuel costs for its lower increase in available seat mile.
The company said higher wages and passenger-driven expenses were partially offset by productivity improvements.
